对话1 我需要停下来去银行取些现金。
Conversation 1 I need to stop at the bank to withdraw some cash.
其实，我已经停止使用在线支付了。过去三个月一直如此。
Well, actually, I've stopped using online payments for the past three months now.
停止在线支付了吗？
Stopped paying online?
哦，你一定很担心在线支付吧。不安全。
Oh, you must be worried that online payments aren't secure.
不，他们很安全。
No, they are safe.
但是网上支付太方便了，我在不该买的东西上花了太多钱需要。
But paying online is too convenient and I spent too much money on things I didn't need.
哦，冲动购物可能会成为一个问题。我也是。
Oh, impulse purchases can be an issue for me too.
我确实买过一些我原本没打算买的衣服和鞋子。因为它们正在打折，所以需要购买。用手机操作太方便了。
I've definitely bought clothes and shoes I didn't need because they were on sale and paying with my phone was so easy.
但我发现，如果我回顾我的每晚的开销让我无法继续消费太多了。
But I've found that if I review my spending every night, that keeps me from spending too much.
我试过那种策略，但根本行不通。因为我整天都要忙着学习，所以没法工作。
I tried that strategy, but it just didn't work because I'd be busy studying all day.
然后当我又累又饿的时候，我就会用我的手机订餐，比如汉堡以及其他垃圾，而不是去食堂里我可以吃到更健康的饭菜。价格减半。
Then when I was tired and hungry, I'd use my phone to order food like burgers and other junk instead of going to the canteen where I could get a healthier meal for half the price.
那你现在该怎么办？
Well, what do you do now then?
看来你也会遇到同样的问题。用现金支付。
It seems like you'd have the same problems with cash.
我每周去一次银行。其余时间我都保持我的银行卡在家里，所以我不能提取更多现金。
I go to the bank once a week and the rest of the time I keep my bank card at home so I can't get more cash out.
我还有一个笔记本，里面记录着……记录我的开支。
And I also have a notebook where I record my expenses.
但是什么阻止你直接前往呢？如果你从银行获得更多资金想买点什么吗？
But what prevents you from just going to the bank and getting more money if you want to buy something?
第一个月我确实额外提取了一些现金。两次，但我为此感到内疚。之后我拒绝再花超过我预算中的金额。
The first month I did withdraw extra cash twice, but I felt guilty about it and after that I refused to spend more than what I had budgeted.
现在这已经成了习惯。
By now, it's just a habit.
对话 2.
Conversation 2.
请听我说完。
Please hear me out.
我不想让我们的儿子把他的即使是下午做他讨厌的事情，他也不愿意。或许能让他为未来做好准备。
I don't want our son to spend his afternoons doing something he hates, even if it might prepare him for the future.
他通过所有的跑步和训练……变得非常健壮，更不用说伟大的每天户外锻炼对身体有益。
From all the running and training he could become quite athletic, not to mention the great physical benefits from exercising outside every day.
我不认为他应该做这件事。他呼吸困难，这给工作带来了很大的挑战。
I don't think he should be doing something so challenging with all his breathing issues.
环境更容易控制，而且他此外，仍然可以进行良好的锻炼。提高他的手眼协调能力。
The environment is easier to control and he can still get a good workout, in addition to improving his hand-eye coordination.
此外，我还可以教他一些东西。我打羽毛球时学到的一些基本技巧。
Besides, I could teach him some of the basics from my time as a badminton player.
我认为团队运动才是正确的方向。走吧。
I'm thinking team sports should be the way to go.
没有什么比参与其中更令人兴奋的了一个单位来完成诸如赢得比赛之类的目标比赛，甚至是冠军赛。
There's nothing like playing as part of a unit to accomplish a goal like winning a game or even a championship.
他可以尝试打篮球，因为很多……现在球场都设在室内了，这是一项运动。这或许能帮助他理解团队精神。与他人合作。
He could try basketball since many of the courts are indoors now and it's a sport that could help him understand team spirit while cooperating with others.
或许他还能加入学校篮球队呢。等他准备好了，就加入球队。
Maybe he could even join the school basketball team when he's ready.
哦，哦，那排球呢？
Oh, oh, what about volleyball?
这是一项团队运动，他们经常……这样他就可以和男女混合球队的成员交流了。男孩和女孩。
It's a team sport and they often have mixed-gender teams so he could socialize with both girls and boys.
它不如某些运动那么受欢迎，这意味着他更有可能获得未来有望获得体育奖学金。
It's not as popular as some sports, which means he has better odds of possibly getting an athletic scholarship in the future.
我还相信你曾是一名沙滩排球运动员。不久前你还是一名运动员。
I also believe you were a beach volleyball athlete yourself not so long ago.
正如我之前多次说过的那样，沙滩排球室内排球则完全不同。
As I've said many times before, beach volleyball and indoor volleyball are completely different.
